title: Not Worth It!
text: Not Worth It!. I purchased this to put my curling iron in while using it, but upon receipt the packaging clearly says it's not for putting a curling iron in while is plugged in!  So, once I unplug it, I can use to to cool the iron??!!  Wow - this should be clearly stated in the large font description!  I would NEVER have purchased this had I known!  This is a great idea that is close to being completely USELESS!  Very disappointed!

product_metadata.title: Polder High-Heat Silicone Hot Sleeve Cover for Flat Iron, Curling Iron, Hair Straightener, Portable Travel Pouch for Hot Hair Styling Tools, Organizer Sleeve for Travel or at Home Use, Black
features: PROTECT COUNTERS AND SUITCASES FROM HEAT: Hot Sleeve High-heat silicone allows hot styling tools to safely cool down while stored; protects up to 450 degrees
COMPACT CORD STORAGE: Two cord hooks hold plug in place when stored, perfect organization for travel
HANGING HOOK: Rear hook hangs on towel bars for easy storage at home or on the go
USE: curling irons up to 2", flat irons up to 1.5", and also works with InStyler
MEASURES: 3" wide x 3.75" deep x 6.25" high
description: The Polder Hot Sleeve is an innovative heat resistant silicone case that safely stores hot styling tools. Designed specifically to fit flat irons up to 1.5-inch / 3.8 cm wide and curling irons up to 2-inch / 5 cm round, the sleeve’s inner walls snugly fit and keep in place popular iron sizes. High-heat silicone withstands temperatures up to 450° F / 232° C so hot styling tools cool down safely. There is no need to wait before storing just used hot tools. Plus, the cord neatly wraps around the silicone body and is held in place by an integrated cord holder eliminating tangled or dangling loose cords. Its compact size is easy to place in a gym bag or suitcase or hung from a towel rod for quick access. Whether for use while travelling, at home, in the dorm room, or post workout, the Hot Sleeve is the perfect solution for storing styling tools.
